summary: cal.diy (Cal.com) is a self-hosted scheduling/booking platform: users configure event types, availability schedules and OOO, manage teams/orgs, upload calendar integrations, and book meetings (Bookings with Attendees/References/Seats/Payments) with webhook notifications, bookings audit trail, and reporting. Mined the 100-model Prisma schema plus tRPC/Next handlers for the core env: 76 schemas, 72 impls, 25 edges.
